# Isuru Marasinghe

> Full-stack digital marketer. Plans, produces and scales paid campaigns across
> Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn and programmatic, and builds the measurement and
> CRM pipeline behind them, from the first three seconds of a hook to the closed
> deal. Works with clients in the UAE, Sri Lanka, the UK and Europe.

Isuru Marasinghe holds an MBA (University of Gloucestershire, UK), ACIM and a
Postgraduate Diploma in Professional Marketing (Chartered Institute of Marketing,
UK, Level 7), AMSLIM (Sri Lanka Institute of Marketing), a Certified Lean Six
Sigma White Belt, the Certified Digital Marketing Practitioner qualification
(American Institute of Professional Qualification, USA) and a first-class BM
(Hons) in Marketing from Horizon Campus, Sri Lanka.

Reported to date: USD 4.5M+ in managed ad spend, USD 61.5M+ in revenue generated,
5,364+ leads from a single Meta account, and a peak Google Ads return of 15.73x.

## Services

- [Meta ads management](https://isurumarasinghe.com/services/meta-ads-management): Facebook and Instagram campaigns built around purchase and qualified-lead events.
- [Google Ads and PPC](https://isurumarasinghe.com/services/google-ads-management): Search, Shopping and Performance Max with attribution that survives scrutiny.
- [TikTok ads management](https://isurumarasinghe.com/services/tiktok-ads-management): Creative-led campaigns on an auction that rewards volume of ideas.
- [LinkedIn ads management](https://isurumarasinghe.com/services/linkedin-ads-management): B2B demand where the cost per click only pays off with a clean funnel.
- [Creative direction and production](https://isurumarasinghe.com/services/creative-direction-production): Concepts, scripts and assets made for the platform they run on.
- [Conversion tracking and GA4](https://isurumarasinghe.com/services/conversion-tracking-ga4): GA4, server-side tagging and the Conversions API, so reporting matches reality.
- [Email, lifecycle and Klaviyo](https://isurumarasinghe.com/services/email-lifecycle-klaviyo): Owned revenue that grows while the paid media does its job.
- [Photography and video production](https://isurumarasinghe.com/services/photography-video-production): Brand and product shoots directed for performance, not for a gallery.
- [Fractional performance marketing lead](https://isurumarasinghe.com/services/fractional-performance-lead): Hands-on ownership of the accounts, narrower than a CMO and deeper in the detail.
- [Fractional CMO](https://isurumarasinghe.com/services/fractional-cmo): Senior marketing leadership across positioning, channel mix, budget and team.

## Case studies

- [5,364 property leads from a Meta account](https://isurumarasinghe.com/case-meta-leads): AED 43.75 blended cost per lead, cheapest ad set at AED 6.48.
- [USD 36.6M closed from direct leads](https://isurumarasinghe.com/case-crm-closings): 75 deals, reported on sale value rather than form fills, against AED 440,000 of media.
- [Purchase-optimised growth on Meta](https://isurumarasinghe.com/case-meta-ecom): E-commerce scaled on purchase value, not on clicks.
- [Google Ads at a 15.73x return on spend](https://isurumarasinghe.com/case-google-ads): Four consecutive monthly snapshots rather than one good month.
- [857 property leads from TikTok Ads](https://isurumarasinghe.com/case-tiktok-leads): Lead generation across 35 campaigns at USD 39 each.
- [Klaviyo email revenue up 55% year on year](https://isurumarasinghe.com/case-klaviyo): Lifecycle flows that grew alongside the list.
